data.gender_notes: Raam is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Raam is recorded with the meaning “God of Ram”. Raam is a Hindu name meaning “God of Ram”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
